fact: Morocco's delegation told COPUOS in June 2024 that it is engaged in projects using Earth observation data, including Mohammed VI A and B satellite images, that yield value-added products and services in areas including agriculture.
system: Earth observation projects using Mohammed VI A and B imagery

fact: The Pôle Digital de l'Agriculture, de la Forêt et Observatoire de la Sécheresse says it now operates a drought-monitoring geoportal using satellite sources (CHIRPS, MODIS, SMAP), crop maps from Sentinel-2 imagery and a farmer agrometeorological e-service with NDVI, SPI and SPEI maps, developed under a FAO-funded LOA that closed 30 May 2026.
system: Pôle Digital géoservices (géoportail sécheresse, e-service agrométéorologique)

fact: A 2024 AgriMaroc report on an INRA book says the CGMS-Maroc drought-alert and cereal-yield forecasting system, run since the early 2010s with INRA, IAV Hassan II, Maroc Météo and the statistics directorate, uses satellite imagery to monitor cereal crops in real time.
